text: Information and Computational Science (lCS) at Xidian University is apromising field that blends Computational Mathematics InformationScience, Data Science and Computer Software to address complexchallenges in science, industry, and society This interdisciplinary majoroffers a wide variety of courses from mathematics and statistics tocomputer science.Students majoring in IcS are required to not onlymaster the necessary theories, methodologies, and programminglanguages but also be able to implement their knowledge and skills tosolve practical problems both independently and collaboratively.
